convert_cell_variable_tuple_to_vec: convert a tuple of CellVariables to a flat JAX array of evolving state variables
convert_flat_vec_to_cell_variable_tuple: convert a flat JAX array of core profile state variables back to a tuple of CellVariables
convert_cell_variable_tuple_to_array: convert a tuple of CellVariables to a multi-dimensional JAX array stacked along a specified axis
concatenate_cell_variable_values: concatenate the values of multiple CellVariables into a single flat array
split_flat_array_into_cell_variables: split a flat array into individual CellVariable values using core profiles and evolving names
